title: Go & Tell
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible story we hear that 
Jesus tells his friends, the disciples
TO GO AND TELL the world all about Him

Jesus stayed on earth for 40 days after rising from the dead.
On the day that a cloud took him back to Heaven
HE GAVE HIS DISCIPLES A TASK
GO and TELL all NATIONS about Jesus
and BAPTISE them
And even more excitingly - JESUS IS COMING BACK TO EARTH
